name: F1 Grand Prix Circuit
description: Formula 1-style circuit inspired by legendary corners from Spa, Silverstone, Monza, and Monaco. Features long straights for overtaking, technical chicanes, fast sweepers, and a challenging hairpin.

turn_1_2.name: Monaco Hairpin
turn_1_2.description: Heavy braking from 250m straight into tight hairpin. Key overtaking opportunity.

turn_3_4.name: Lesmo Chicane
turn_3_4.description: Quick left-right flick inspired by Monza. Tests precision and car balance.

turn_5_6_7.name: Maggotts-Becketts Complex
turn_5_6_7.description: High-speed flowing sequence like Silverstone. High commitment, high reward.

turn_8.name: Spoon Curve
turn_8.description: Long right-hander with double apex, inspired by Suzuka.

turn_9_10_11.name: Bus Stop Chicane
turn_9_10_11.description: Tight technical sequence like Spa. Requires precision and momentum management.

turn_12_13.name: Final Complex
turn_12_13.description: Critical for overtaking setup into Turn 1. Exit speed crucial for main straight.

sector_1.description: Speed sector with long straight and technical chicane

sector_2.description: Technical sector with fast esses and long sweeper

sector_3.description: Precision sector with tight chicane and final complex

map_config.notes: Wider lanes (8m) and 3 lanes total for multi-agent side-by-side racing

overtaking_opportunities: Into Turn 1 (Monaco Hairpin) after main straight - PRIMARY
Into Turn 8 (Spoon Curve) after Hangar Straight - SECONDARY
Into Bus Stop Chicane after straight - TERTIARY
key_corners_for_laptime: Turn 1-2: Get close to inside, late apex, maximize exit onto straight
Turn 5-6-7: Maintain speed through esses, smooth inputs critical
Turn 12-13: Exit speed crucial for main straight speed
ai_training_notes: Hairpin teaches heavy braking and slow-speed control
Chicanes teach precision and quick direction changes
Fast esses teach commitment and smooth inputs
Multiple sectors test different aspects of driving
Wide enough for 2-3 agents to race side-by-side

geometry_verification.note: Track closes perfectly with 360° net clockwise rotation
